responsibility: This module covers GCC’s loop-optimization subsystem across both the GIMPLE/polyhedral and RTL stages, centered on analyses and transforms that recognize, restructure, and lower loops for better performance. Its Graphite files implement the polyhedral pipeline for loop nests: detecting SESE-based SCoPs, lowering them into isl-based polyhedral representations, computing dependence relations, optimizing schedules such as tiling or parallel-friendly reorderings, and regenerating transformed GIMPLE. Its classic RTL loop files provide the lower-level loop framework and transformations used after RTL expansion, including loop initialization and pass orchestration, induction-variable and trip-count analysis, loop-invariant code motion, unrolling and peeling, hardware doloop formation for target low-overhead loop instructions, and modulo scheduling/software pipelining. Together, these file families make this module the place where GCC analyzes loop structure, legality, profitability, and target execution properties in order to transform loops from high-level nest optimization down to machine-oriented loop control and scheduling.
